title: Parmesan Garlic Crumbed Fish with Green Beans
description: Twenty minutes, and the mustard is what makes it work: it glues the crumb to the fish and cuts the parmesan. Any firm white fish will do.

steps.text: Combine the breadcrumbs, parsley, parmesan, garlic, olive oil and a pinch of salt in a bowl and stir well.
Season the two pieces of fish with salt and pepper, then spread the mustard all over each fillet.
Press the fish into the crumb mixture to coat it, and spray with a little olive oil if you have it.
Cook the fish in a non-stick frying pan with a little olive oil, or bake it in the oven.
Serve with steamed or sauteed green beans.

notes: Any white fish works. Snapper is what the source used.
